question: Could you tell me the first names of customers who spent less than $1 on albums by the best-selling artist, along with the amounts they spent?
sql:
-- Find customers who bought Iron Maiden tracks and their total spending on those tracks
SELECT c.FirstName, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS spent_on_iron_maiden
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN artists a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON inv.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE a.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
GROUP BY c.FirstName
HAVING SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) < 1.0
ORDER BY spent_on_iron_maiden;
